newsitem.title: USA: Sun hires Northeast marketing chief.
newsitem.headline: Sun hires Northeast marketing chief.

text.p: Sun Co Inc said Robert W. Owens has joined the company as vice president and general manager in charge of Sunoco Northeast Marketing, one of Sun's seven major business units.
Sunoco Northeast Marketing markets Sunoco gasoline and other products in 12 Mid-Atlantic and New England states through 2,900 retail sites, the company said.
It said Owens, comes to Sun from Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp, where he had been vice president of Marketing and Services in Hanford, Calif.
The post he fills at Sun had been open since last fall.

At Ultramar Diamond Shamrock, Owens was in charge of the company's U.S. product supply, distribution and marketing activities, which are focused in California, Nevada and Arizona. He had reported to Jack Drosdick, who recently joined Sun Co as president and chief operating officer.
